AzureVoiceLive.// Model: Inherits from ContactCenterAgent.Shared.VoiceLive.VoiceLiveDefaults.Model (currently 'gpt-realtime-1.5'). Override here to A/B test a different model in the lab without touching prod, e.g. 'gpt-realtime' (legacy GA) or 'gpt-realtime-mini' (Basic-tier, cheaper).
AzureVoiceLive.// Voice/VoiceType/Temperature: All inherited from VoiceLiveDefaults (single source of truth shared with caller-agent). Override here ONLY to A/B test a different voice for the lab without touching prod. Examples: 'Voice': 'da-DK-Jeppe:DragonHDOmniLatestNeural' (male HD Omni) | 'da-DK-ChristelNeural' (standard neural — also unset Temperature). HD voices require Sweden Central / westeurope / etc.
